propositions: docs/releasing.md incorrectly describes the pypi GitHub environment required-reviewers rule as 'the second human approval' when it is actually a single configured reviewer (the release identity) with self-review permitted and admin bypass enabled

docs/releasing.md and .github/workflows/release.yml falsely claim the pypi deployment approval is an interactive human prompt, when the actual mechanism is a non-interactive REST API call to pending_deployments

the approval mechanism guarantees identity and ref control over who can release the publish job (only listed reviewer can approve that specific run from main), but does not provide independent second-party code review

the correct non-interactive approval procedure requires a POST to pending_deployments with a properly-typed JSON body (environment_ids as integer array, not string flags), preceded by a GET read to discover the environment id
